Reference and competitor code. Not part of any single repo's build.

| Directory | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **openfang** | [RightNow-AI/openfang](https://github.com/RightNow-AI/openfang) — Rust "Agent OS", 10k+ stars. Cloned for comparison and to avoid namespace overlap; our orchestration hub is **RoboFang** (Sandra-class, Python). |
| **nanoclaw** | [qwibitai/nanoclaw](https://github.com/qwibitai/nanoclaw) — Lightweight AI assistant (TypeScript, ~500 LOC). Container isolation, WhatsApp/Telegram, agent swarms, SQLite memory. Security-focused alternative to OpenClaw. |

Clone with:
- `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/RightNow-AI/openfang.git openfang`
- `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/qwibitai/nanoclaw.git nanoclaw`
